The Parliament of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland [ g ] is the supreme legislative body of the United Kingdom , and may also legislate for the Crown Dependencies and the British Overseas Territories . [ h ] [ 6 ] [ 7 ] Since 1999, varying degrees of powers have been devolved to the national parliaments of Northern Ireland , Scotland , and Wales . [ 8 ] Each devolved parliament has different devolved powers, with Scotland being the most powerful amongst the three devolved parliaments. [ 9 ] The central UK Parliament retains the power to legislate in reserved matters , including broadcasting, defence, and currency. [ 10 ]
